transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Thank you for making time for this roundtable. The borrower has made all scheduled interest and principal payments on time. Bank policy requires this recorded pre-decision roundtable with risk, legal, relationship coverage, and loan operations before I can finalize a covenant waiver decision. I'd like to go around the table and hear each of your perspectives so I can make an informed binding decision. Let's start with risk -- what's your read on the covenant breach and the borrower's request?
